headline: Cyberattack disables fridges at French supermarkets
summary: A cyberattack remotely raised refrigeration temperatures at French supermarket chains, spoiling stock. One outlet names Danfoss controllers as the target and outdated firmware as a factor; researchers reportedly warned of the risk months earlier, in August.

claims.statement: A cyberattack remotely disabled or raised the temperature of supermarket refrigeration, spoiling food.

sources.quote: A cyberattack has hit supermarkets in Europe, disabling refrigerators.
Attackers remotely defrosted refrigerators at multiple French supermarket chains overnight
Cyberattacks crank French supermarket refrigeration systems up to 50°C
A cyber-attack caused refrigeration temperatures to soar to 50C overnight on Monday across several hundred French supermarkets

claims.statement: The attack reportedly targeted Danfoss refrigeration controllers.

claims.statement: The manufacturer said the affected equipment was running outdated firmware.

sources.quote: Stock spoiled at hundreds of stores as manufacturer says affected equipment ran outdated firmware
